```{r}
# 702 body and tail
# 703 head
# 704 total 全摘

df_panc <- df_surg_dem_total %>% 
  filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "K700|^K702|^K703|^K704")) %>%
  mutate(TX = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") & !str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Lap",
                        str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") &  str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Robotic",
                        .default = "Open") ) %>%
  
  
  mutate(LOC = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "膵頭") ~ "Head",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "膵体尾部") ~ "Distal",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "全摘") ~ "Total",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700", "K700-4") ~ "Middle",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700-2", "K700-3") ~ "Enucleation")) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c("Open", "Lap", "Robotic"))) %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC, levels = c("Head", "Distal", "Total", "Middle", "Enucleation")))
```

```{r}
df_bil <- df_surg_dem_total %>%

df_bil
```

```{r}
df_panc_all <- df_panc %>%
  group_by(YEAR, LOC) %>%
  summarise(SUM = sum(TOTAL)) %>%
  bind_rows(df_panc %>%
              group_by(YEAR) %>%
              summarise(SUM = sum(TOTAL)) %>%
              mutate(LOC = "All")) %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC, levels = c("All",
                                      "Head",
                                      "Distal",
                                      "Total",
                                      "Middle",
                                      "Enucleation"))) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))
```

```{r}

p1_a1 <- df_panc_all %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(YEAR %in% c(2014, 2024) & !(LOC %in% c("Middle", "Enucleation")  )~ scales::comma(SUM),
                           .default = NA)) %>%

  mutate(hjust = case_when(YEAR == 2014 & LOC == "All" ~ 0,
                           YEAR == 2014 & LOC != "All" ~ 0,
                       YEAR == 2024 ~ 0.5,
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(vjust = case_when(YEAR == 2014 & LOC == "All" ~ 1,
                           YEAR %in% c(2014, 2024) ~ 0,
                           .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(y = case_when(YEAR == 2014 & LOC == "All" ~ SUM - 20000/20,
                       YEAR %in% c(2014, 2024) ~ SUM + 20000/20,
                           .default = NA)) %>%
  
  ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(YEAR, SUM, group = LOC, colour = LOC), linewidth = 0.3)+
  geom_point(aes(YEAR, SUM, colour = LOC), size = 1)+
  geom_text(aes(x = YEAR, y = y, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, 
                label = label),
            size = 2.8, colour = "black")+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#8c564b",
                                 "#1f77b4",
                                 "#d62728",
                                 "#bcbd22",
                                 "#e377c2",
                                 "#17becf"),
                          labels = c("All",
                                     "Head",
                                     "Distal",
                                     "Total",
                                     "Middle",
                                     "Enucleation"),
                    name = "Pancreatectomy")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, 2),
                     limits = c(2014, 2024))+
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20000, 5000),
                     limits = c(0, 20000),
                     label = scales::label_comma())+
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1) )+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Count (n)",
       tag = "a")+
       #title = "Pancreatomy")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 5, 1, 0, unit = "mm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 1, 0, "mm"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "mm"))

p1_a1
```


```{r}
# proportion

p1_a2 <- df_panc_all %>%
  filter(LOC != "All") %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC,
                      levels = c("Enucleation",
                                 "Middle",
                                 "Total",
                                 "Distal",
                                 "Head"))) %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(ALL = sum(SUM)) %>%
  mutate(PCT = SUM/ALL * 100) %>%
  mutate(label = round(PCT)) %>%
  mutate(label = na_if(label, LOC == "Total")) %>%
  mutate(y = case_when(LOC == "Head" ~ 30,
                       LOC == "Distal" ~80,
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.character(YEAR)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(YEAR, PCT, fill = LOC))+
  geom_col(width = 0.75)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#17becf",
                                 "#e377c2",
                                 "#bcbd22",
                                "#d62728",
                                 "#1f77b4"),
                    name = "Pancreatectomy")+
  geom_text(aes(y = y, label = label),
            size = 2.8, colour ="white")+
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Proportion (%)")+
  scale_x_discrete(
               #    limits = c(2014, 2024) %>% as.character(),
                   breaks = seq(2014, 2024, 2))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand  = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 25))+
  theme_classic()+
   theme(# plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 5, unit = "mm"),
        legend.position = "none")

p1_a2
```

```{r}
df_label_d2 <- df_panc_tx  %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(TX != "All") %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(PCT = SUM/sum(SUM) * 100 ) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c( "Robotic", "Lap", "Open"))) %>%
  arrange(TX) %>%
  mutate(CS = cumsum(PCT)) %>%
  mutate(HT = CS - PCT* 1/2) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when( TX == "Open" |
                              TX == "Lap" & YEAR >= 2018 |
                              TX == "Robotic" & YEAR %in% c(2023, 2024) ~ round(PCT),
                            .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(vjust = 0.5) %>%
  
  mutate(y = case_when(TX == "Open" ~ 50,
                       TX == "Lap" ~ HT,
                       TX == "Robotic" ~ 5,
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(colour = case_when(TX %in% c("Open", "Robotic") ~ "a",
                            TX == "Lap" ~ "b"))

df_label_d2
```

```{r}
                       YEAR == 2024 & TX %in% c( "Open") ~ SUM + 12000/20,
```

```{r}
p1_c1 <- df_panc_loc %>%
  filter(LOC == "Distal") %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(YEAR %in% c(2014, 2024) ~ scales::comma(SUM),
                           .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(hjust = case_when(YEAR == 2014 ~ 0,
                           YEAR == 2024 & TX == "Robotic" ~ 0.5,
                           YEAR == 2024 ~ 0.5,
                           .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(vjust = case_when(YEAR == 2014 & TX == "Open" ~ 1,
                           YEAR == 2014 & TX == "Lap" ~ 0,
                           YEAR == 2024 & TX == "Robotic" ~ 1,
                           .default = 0)) %>%
  
  mutate(x  = case_when(hjust == 1 ~ YEAR - 10/50,
                        .default = YEAR)) %>%
  
  
  mutate(y  = case_when(YEAR == 2014 & TX == "Open" ~ SUM - 5000/20,
                        YEAR == 2024 & TX == "Robotic" ~ SUM - 5000/20,
                        !is.na(x) ~ SUM + 5000/20,
                        .default = SUM)) %>%
  
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(YEAR, SUM, colour = TX, group = TX),
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(YEAR, SUM, colour = TX),
             size = 1)+
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = y, label = label,
                hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
            size = 2.8, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c( "#2ca02c",
                                 "#ff7f0e",
                                 "#9467bd"),
                    name = "Distal pancreas",
                    labels = c(
                               "Open",
                               "Laparoscopic",
                               "Robotic"))+
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, 2),
                     limits = c(2014, 2024))+
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5000),
                     breaks = seq(0, 5000, 1000),
                     labels = scales::label_comma())+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Count (n)",
       tag = "c")+
       #title = "Pancreatomy")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", hjust = 0.5),

        legend.position = "bottom",
```

```{r}
df_label_c2 <- df_panc_loc %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(LOC == "Distal") %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(TOTAL = sum(SUM)) %>%
  mutate(PCT = SUM/TOTAL * 100) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c("Robotic", "Lap", "Open"))) %>%
  arrange(YEAR, TX) %>%
  mutate(CS = cumsum(PCT)) %>%
  mutate(HT = CS - PCT/2) %>%
  
  mutate(label = case_when(TX == "Open"  |
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR <= 2019 |
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR >= 2020 |
                       TX == "Robotic" & YEAR %in% c(2022:2024) ~ round(PCT),
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  
  mutate(y = case_when(TX == "Open" ~ 75,
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR <= 2019 ~ 5,
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR >= 2020 ~ HT,
                       TX == "Robotic" & YEAR %in% c(2022:2024) ~ 5)) %>%
  mutate(vjust = case_when(TX == "Open" ~ 0.5,
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR <= 2019 ~ 0.5,
                       TX == "Lap" & YEAR >= 2020 ~ 0.5,
                       TX == "Robotic" & YEAR %in% c(2022:2024) ~ 0.5,
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(colour = case_when(TX == "Lap" ~ "a",
                            .default = "b")) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c("Robotic", "Lap", "Open"))) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.character(YEAR))

df_label_c2
```

```{r}
get_exp <- function(x){

  # if na return ""
  
  if(is.nan(x) | x > 0.001){
    return("")
  }
  
  else {
    
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    ex <- p %>% str_extract("(?<=e).+") %>% str_remove_all("(?<=\\-)0+") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "−")
    
    return(ex)
    }
}

get_expv <- Vectorize(get_exp)
```

```{r}
get_num <- function(x){
  
  if (is.nan(x)){
      return("NA")
    }
  
  else if (x > 0.001) {
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  else{
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    num <- p %>% str_extract(".+(?=e)")
    
    num <- str_c(num, "×10")
      
    return(num)
  }
}

get_numv <- Vectorize(get_num)
```

```{r}
symbol_p <- function(x){
  if (is.nan(x)){
    return("")
  }
  else if (x < 0.001){
    return("***")
    }
  else if (x < 0.01){
    return("**")
  }
  else if (x < 0.05){
    return("*")
  }
  else {
    return("")
  }
}

symbol_pv <- Vectorize(symbol_p)
```
